images.title: Cancel pairs across the bar
images.purpose: Shows the core move of the practice tool: in 3⁵ ÷ 3², two matching pairs cancel and three 3s are left.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text. One large fraction in the centre with factors above and below the bar, and the result on the right.
images.exact_structure: A horizontal fraction bar. Above it, exactly 5 equal teal (#0072B2) boxes each showing '3'; below it, exactly 2 equal teal (#0072B2) boxes each showing '3', under the first two upper boxes. The first two upper boxes and both lower boxes are struck through with a thick grey (#6B7280) diagonal line each, and each cancelled pair is joined by a thin grey (#6B7280) link. The 3 remaining upper boxes have a thick amber (#E69F00) outline. To the left of the fraction, the label '3⁵ ÷ 3²'. To the right, an arrow to the label '3³' in a reddish purple (#CC79A7) rounded box, and under it the label '5 − 2 = 3'. Exactly 7 boxes, 4 struck through, 2 links, 1 arrow.

images.takeaway: Dividing powers of the same base subtracts the exponents.
images.description: Shows the core move of the practice tool: in 3⁵ ÷ 3², two matching pairs cancel and three 3s are left.
images.context: 3 to the power 5 divided by 3² leaves 3³, which is 27. The practice item rewrites 4 to the power 32 as 2 to the power 64 before subtracting.

image_decisions.why: The practice tool cancels matching factors across a fraction bar; this picture shows that manipulation in its simplest state.
